privacy.en:
Effective for SiteRevisit 1.0. Hailink Labs.

Your jobsite records

Projects, viewpoints, original photos and reports are stored locally on your device. SiteRevisit does not upload them to Hailink Labs. It has no account signup, advertising, third-party analytics SDK or automatic cloud synchronization.

Permissions and purchases

The camera is used only when you choose to capture a photo. Single-photo import uses Apple's photo picker without requesting full library access. SiteRevisit does not request microphone, location, contacts or tracking permission. Apple processes purchases and purchase restoration through StoreKit; the app keeps verified access information locally.

Exports and backups

You choose whether to save or share PDF, CSV, original photos or backups. The Files or sharing provider you select may process the exported content under its own policies. Files stored in iCloud Drive are user-controlled file backups, not automatic SiteRevisit sync. Backups contain your photos and are not password-encrypted; save them in a location you control.

Retention and deletion

Archive retains records. Trash is not automatically emptied. Permanent deletion requires confirmation. Full data restoration replaces the current workspace and retains the previous workspace as a safety copy until explicit cleanup. App removal, device loss or damage can lose local data that has not been exported or backed up.

Your choices

You can view, correct existing text, export, back up, restore data and delete records even after trial expiry. Restoring an Apple purchase does not restore local photos. You should have permission to photograph and share site content.

Support

Contact gaozichen@hailinklabs.com with privacy questions, or visit Hailink Labs contact. Do not send private photos or a full backup unless you intentionally choose to share them.
privacy.zh-CN:
适用于 SiteRevisit 1.0，Hailink Labs。

现场记录

项目、点位、原始照片和报告保存在设备本地，SiteRevisit 不向 Hailink Labs 上传这些内容。没有注册账号、广告、第三方分析 SDK 或自动云同步。

权限与购买

仅在你选择拍摄时使用相机。单张照片导入使用 Apple 照片选择器，不申请完整图库权限。不请求麦克风、位置、通讯录或追踪权限。Apple 通过 StoreKit 处理购买和恢复购买，App 在本地保存经过验证的访问状态。

导出和备份

是否保存或分享 PDF、CSV、原图和备份由你决定。你选择的文件或分享提供者可能按自身政策处理内容。iCloud Drive 中的文件是用户控制的备份，不是 App 自动同步。备份含照片且无密码加密，请保存在受控位置。

保留与删除

归档保留记录，废纸篓不自动清空。永久删除需要确认。全量恢复替换当前工作区，同时保留上一个工作区作为安全副本，直到明确清理。卸载 App、设备丢失或损坏可能造成未导出或备份的本地资料丢失。

你的选择

试用到期后仍可查看、修改已有文字、导出、备份、恢复数据和删除记录。恢复 Apple 购买不会恢复本地照片。拍摄和分享现场内容需要你拥有相应许可。

支持

隐私问题请联系 Hailink Labs 支持。除非你主动决定分享，不要发送私密照片或完整备份。

support.en:
Hailink Labs · SiteRevisit

Before leaving the site

Open Check before leaving. Photograph every pending viewpoint or enter a reason to skip it. A skipped viewpoint is not counted as photographed. Save & Exit resumes the same open visit later.

Saving and photos

Wait for Saved before relying on a new photograph. If saving fails, retry after checking free storage and camera permission. Retake saves a new photo before replacing its reference, keeping the previous version. If an original is missing, recover from a full backup; do not uninstall or clear data to solve the error.

Back up and restore

Settings → Prepare full backup → Save backup to Files. Backups include all records, original photos and saved reports, and are not password-encrypted. Restore data from backup performs a full replacement after validation. Your previous workspace is retained as a safety copy. Purchase access is never imported from a data backup.

Purchases

Start the 7-Day Trial when you are ready. It does not charge automatically. Lifetime Access is a separate one-time purchase. Restore Purchases asks Apple to recover verified access; it does not restore photos. Trial expiry keeps history and exports available and lets you finish already-started visits.

Getting help

Email gaozichen@hailinklabs.com or visit Hailink Labs contact. Include the App version, action and exact error message. Keep your backup. Do not send customer photos or backups unless you intentionally choose to share them.
support.zh-CN:
离开现场前

打开 Check before leaving，为每个未处理点位拍照或填写跳过原因。跳过不计为已拍。Save & Exit 后可继续同一轮回访。

保存和照片

等待 Saved 再依赖新照片。保存失败时检查可用空间和相机权限后重试。重拍先保存新照片再替换引用，并保留旧版本。原图丢失时从全量备份恢复，不要卸载或清空数据。

备份和恢复

Settings → Prepare full backup → Save backup to Files。备份含全部记录、原图和已保存报告，无密码加密。恢复先校验再全量替换，旧工作区保留为安全副本。数据备份不导入购买权益。

购买

准备好后主动开始七天试用，不自动收费。Lifetime Access 是独立的一次性购买。Restore Purchases 向 Apple 恢复经过验证的访问权，不恢复照片。试用到期仍可查看历史、导出，并完成已开始的回访。

获取帮助

联系支持时请提供 App 版本、操作和准确错误信息，并保留备份。除非你主动决定分享，不要发送客户照片或完整备份。
